scope: Finite scalar moment recursion over ramified K, exact contracting transports, certified positive moments and transfer to all matched CM charts.

sources.title: Cameron Franc and Marc Masdeu, Computing fundamental domains for the Bruhat-Tits tree for GL2(Qp), p-adic automorphic forms, and the canonical embedding of Shimura curves
sources.use: Harmonic measures, finite-chart moments, iterative moment lifting and Poisson evaluation as the methodological framework. The scalar contracting equations and precision bounds needed over our ramified K are proved directly from ball partitions and d=0; no Qp control theorem or constants are transferred.

sources.title: Marc Masdeu and Eloi Torrents, Fundamental domains for quaternionic S-arithmetic groups over totally real fields
sources.use: Column-lattice tree and edge representatives over completions of totally real fields. Existing D111 arithmetic is reused; no external implementation or expanded tree-domain search is run.

local_sources.use: Conditional moment-to-Poisson and coarse differential coefficient formulas, including their dyadic division and tail bounds.
The exact splitting algebra and fixed Hensel branch, with root error 180.
The existing 174 arithmetic transports, local directions and class indexing.
All local frames, sixteen integral scalar measures and their uniform denominator bound d=0.
Certified CM chart reduction and independent depth-three leaf-ball masses.
Exact coordinates S for all seventeen arithmetically matched CM points.
The existing CM labels, rational residue frame, zeroth chart masses and 682 inherited source hashes.

project_deductions: Every canonical edge chart partitions into two children carried back to saved slots by the existing arithmetic transport. All 348 coordinate maps have denominator slope in pi*O_K and determinant valuation one.
Writing phi=b+delta*x/(1+c*x), with valuations of delta and c at least one, gives coefficient valuation at least k for x^k in every positive power phi^n.

Fixing degree-zero masses gives a strictly contracting positive-moment operator. Cutoff J, working precision P and N iterations certify error at least min(J+1,P,N). A zero residual uniquely certifies the moments modulo pi^P.
All 51 CM coordinate transports are ball isomorphisms. Their degree-n coefficient tails have valuation at least k-n, so transfer from the state bank gives error min(P,J+1-n).
The pi^12 pilot retains degrees 0 through 11, runs 12 iterations, and supplies 33408 moment entries. Its exact two-bit-plane quotient representation retains v_pi(2)=8.
Independent ordinary polynomial convolution and integer matrix arithmetic certify all moment residuals and CM transfers, separately from the pilot's bit-plane implementation.
Direct degree-three and lower Riemann sums on 32 independently reduced leaf balls agree modulo pi^3, with error proved using the integral measure bound.
Among 2448 positive-degree CM entries, 2043 are certified nonzero. The 144 anchor entries are all congruent to zero at their error bounds; no exact vanishing or normalization is inferred.

software.name: Python standard library
software.use: Exact rational splitting arithmetic, integer quotient arithmetic, bounded process-group execution and source hashes.

software.name: NumPy

excluded_inferences: The two-bit-plane implementation is restricted to precision at most 16; higher precision requires an extended quotient implementation using the full Eisenstein polynomial.
No final-scale runtime claim follows from this low-precision pilot or the mathematical contraction theorem.
No exact vanishing at W and no certified anchor normalization or Gaussian pivot.
No actual Shimura differential value or jet, harmonic-to-residue frame change, candidate identification or target field polynomial.
No new class census, level, Hecke bank or cubic-precision run.
No direct exponential Riemann refinement as the high-precision algorithm; only a fixed small independent validation sample is used.
No unchanged Qp overconvergent control theorem or inert-31 equality threshold is applied over K.
